name: Improvement proportion (asset-level qualification for fund 70% threshold)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.28-4.31 — minimum 70% of fund assets must be on an improvement trajectory for the Sustainability Improvers label)

summary: PS23/16 requires ≥70% of fund assets to be on a sustainability improvement trajectory for the Sustainability Improvers label. At the project (asset) level, this criterion tests whether the asset would qualify toward the fund's 70% numerator. Asset-level qualification cascades from the four upstream Improvers criteria (c5 baseline, c6 strategy, c7 targets, c8 monitoring) — if all four are aligned the asset counts; if any are not_aligned the asset does not count. Fund-level 70% aggregation is the FMP's job; PB certifies the asset's eligibility status.
